insights.one_liner: Utrecht consultancy improving processes, IT and projects from a finance and risk angle; mostly senior roles, and not an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: A small advisory firm (about 195 people on LinkedIn) that promises working solutions instead of thick reports, with the motto 'It can always be better!'.
Staff mostly studied economics, business, international business and accounting at VU, Tilburg, Erasmus, UvA and Avans.
Runs a 'Young Improven' development programme for starting consultants.
